description: Open-source app to configure gaming peripherals on Windows and Linux, without SteelSeries GG or Logitech G HUB.
notes: PeriHub needs access to your HID devices. On Windows it is installed per-user by default and does not require administrator rights.
Update PeriHub with 'scoop update perihub' rather than its in-app updater: the in-app updater launches the vendor installer, which would leave a second copy of PeriHub outside Scoop.
